hero.description: I build performant, accessible, and beautifully crafted web applications. Currently freelancing on GitHub for Expensify and engineering the Quantum ELD platform at Longhorn Logistics.

about.title: Crafting digital experiences with code & care
about.p1: I'm a Senior Frontend Engineer with 5 years of real production experience building modern web applications. My journey began with HTML, CSS, and a curiosity that turned into a career.
about.p2: Today I work on the Quantum ELD platform at Longhorn Logistics — rebuilding it with the React ecosystem (React Query, Tailwind, Vite, Radix UI) — and contribute as a freelancer to Expensify's open-source codebase on GitHub.
about.p3: I care deeply about performance, accessibility, and the small details that separate good products from great ones. I believe great UI is invisible — it just feels right.

experience.title: 5 years of building things that matter
experience.subtitle: A timeline of companies I've helped grow and products I've helped ship.

longhorn.description: Building a modern ELD platform for the US logistics industry. Rewrote the frontend using React, React Query for server-state, Tailwind for UI, Vite for fast builds, and Radix UI for accessible primitives. Materially improved performance, maintainability, and UX.
highlights: Migrated legacy frontend to a modern React stack
Reduced bundle size and improved Time to Interactive
Implemented optimistic updates and caching layer

expensify.description: Contributing to Expensify's New Expensify open-source React Native project on GitHub. Picking up issues, shipping fixes, and collaborating with maintainers on a production-scale codebase.
highlights: Shipped PRs against a real-world cross-platform codebase
Worked across React Native, TypeScript, and Onyx
Engaged with code review at scale

zamonaviy.description: Designed and developed CRM platforms, admin dashboards, and WMS systems. Deep work with Vue 2, Vue 3, Bootstrap-Vue, and Nuxt 3. Delivered scalable solutions for complex business requirements.
highlights: Architected several CRM and WMS dashboards from scratch
Led migration from Vue 2 to Vue 3 + Pinia
Built design system used across multiple internal products

prom.description: Developed e-commerce experiences with Nuxt 3 and Tailwind CSS Premium. Built an admin dashboard for Med24 streamlining medical operations, and created patient-facing medical sites.

datasite.description: First professional role. Built websites and admin dashboards with HTML, CSS, React, WordPress, Bootstrap, and Sass. Focused on responsive design and intuitive UX.
highlights: Learned the discipline of shipping under deadlines
